tokens.name: olive-900

tokens.name: olive-800
tokens.usage: Olive strong: primary-button hover fill; secondary/ghost button and IconButton label color on cream (≥7.5:1).

tokens.name: olive-700
tokens.usage: Brand olive — the trailer body. Primary button fill, inverse blocks (headers, footers, menu board), control borders, checked Checkbox/Radio.

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Olive step between brand and olive-500.

tokens.name: olive-500
tokens.usage: Input hover border (3.6:1 on cream-100).

tokens.name: olive-300
tokens.usage: Text selection background; the menu board's MENU label on olive-700 — 2.8:1 there, under the 3:1 floor for 20px bold text (source pair, kept).

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Olive tint: secondary/ghost hover fill, default Badge fill (olive-900 text on it 7.8:1).

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Brightest cream: card surface, form controls; text on rust-600 (5.2:1) and moss-600 (4.1:1 — under 4.5:1 for the 12px Badge label; source pair, kept).

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Brand cream — the trailer lettering. Page background; text and logo on olive-700 (5.5:1) and olive-800.

tokens.name: cream-300
tokens.usage: Muted cream: secondary text on the olive menu board (4.9:1 on olive-700).

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Kraft paper, light step.

tokens.usage: Kraft paper background for alternate sections; pair cards on it with the hairline border-soft.

tokens.name: paper-300
tokens.usage: Kraft paper, dark step.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Near-black of the trailer roof and chassis: the menu board's frame border.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body-copy ink (as text-body) on cream and paper (≥9.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text (as text-muted) on cream-100, cream-200 (≥6.3:1) and paper-200 (5.1:1).

tokens.name: rust-600

tokens.name: moss-600
tokens.usage: Success and open now: moss Badge fill with cream-100 text (4.1:1 — under 4.5:1 at the Badge's 12px size; source pair, kept).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body text color on surface-page, surface-card and surface-paper. Note: the stylesheet's typography variable of the same name (--text-body, the body font shorthand) is declared after this one and wins, so var(--text-body) resolves to the font shorthand, not this color — as in the original styles.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline: flat Card border, input borders, dot leaders. 1.3:1 on cream-100 — below the 3:1 floor for control borders (source value, kept).

tokens.name: border-strong

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline, offset 2px, on every control. About 2:1 on cream — below the 3:1 floor for focus indicators (source value, kept).
